DisableTelemetry.title: Turn off telemetry
DisableTelemetry.what: No technical or usage data is sent to Mozilla. The data collection options in settings become unavailable.

DisableFirefoxStudies.title: Turn off studies and experiments
DisableFirefoxStudies.what: Mozilla can no longer enroll the browser in studies (Shield) or push remote pref changes (Normandy).

DontCheckDefaultBrowser.title: Stop asking to be the default browser
DontCheckDefaultBrowser.what: Firefox no longer asks at startup. You can still set it in settings.

DisableAccounts.title: Turn off Firefox Account and Sync
DisableAccounts.what: You cannot sign in to a Firefox Account. Bookmarks, passwords and tabs stop syncing. Local data stays in the profile.

PasswordManagerEnabled.title: Turn off the built-in password manager
PasswordManagerEnabled.what: Firefox stops storing and offering saved logins. Proton Pass is auto-installed as the replacement.

OfferToSaveLogins.title: Stop offering to save logins
OfferToSaveLogins.what: Firefox does not ask whether to remember a password.

AutofillAddressEnabled.title: Turn off address autofill
AutofillAddressEnabled.what: Forms no longer fill your address automatically. You type it every time.

AutofillCreditCardEnabled.title: Turn off credit card autofill
AutofillCreditCardEnabled.what: Payment forms no longer fill your card details automatically.

FirefoxHome.title: Remove sponsored content and stories from the new tab
FirefoxHome.what: Sponsored shortcuts, recommended stories and sponsored stories are gone from Firefox Home.

FirefoxSuggest.title: Turn off Firefox Suggest
FirefoxSuggest.what: Address bar suggestions from Mozilla are gone. What you type is not sent to Mozilla for suggestions.

UserMessaging.title: Remove Mozilla messages and recommendations
UserMessaging.what: Extension and feature suggestions, address bar interventions, the onboarding screen and the More from Mozilla section are gone.

AIControls.title: Block AI features
AIControls.what: Sidebar chatbot, link previews, smart tab groups, PDF alt text, Smart Window and speech recognition are blocked. Local translation stays available unless it is blocked too.

SearchEngines.title: Set Brave Search as the default engine
SearchEngines.what: Searches in the address bar and search box go to Brave Search instead of the built-in default.

ExtensionSettings.title: Auto-install the curated extension set
ExtensionSettings.what: uBlock Origin, Proton Pass, Privacy Badger, TWP, PopUpOFF, Popup Blocker and CanvasBlocker are installed and cannot be removed by accident.

Preferences.title: Apply individual preferences
Preferences.what: Ad attribution submission and trending searches in the address bar are turned off.

DisableDefaultBrowserAgent.title: Turn off the Windows default browser agent
DisableDefaultBrowserAgent.what: The background agent that reports your default browser stops running. Windows only.
